item.title: Version 1.3.29
item.description: Fixes for Session Setup: the runner now touches only the tracks it created from the delivery (template tracks, even ones with audio or instrument names, are ignored; a stopped run is not resumed after the rename, start again from a fresh template session); the delivery's rough mix replaces whatever is on the template's ROUGH MIX track; progress lines while Pro Tools opens a new session on a slow drive; the update log no longer reports 'up to date' as an error.
